title: Strong comparison principle and symmetry results for the fractional $p$-Laplacian
summary: In this article, we study the equation $$ (-Δ_p)^s u = f(u) $$ in a bounded domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^n$, where $n\geq 2$, $p>2$, and $f$ is locally Lipschitz. We establish a strong comparison principle in a fairly general setting and use it to derive symmetry results for positive $C^1$ solutions satisfying Dirichlet boundary conditions. We also show that the $C^1$ regularity assumption is indeed satisfied for $p\in \left[2,\frac{2}{1-s}\right)$.
